The lowest common ancestor of Morphine and Codeine is identified as an Organic Heteropentacyclic Compound, suggesting a shared structural or functional basis in the opioid pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Morphine and Ugt2b4, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
